title: Little artist
theme: Art, shapes and materials; making my first storybook

canDo: Say what I am doing now
Describe a picture: shapes, colours, where things are
Ask for things politely: 'Can you pass me the ...?'
Tell a short story with my drawings
grammar: present continuous: I'm drawing / she's painting

chunks.example: What are you doing, Pip? I'm painting the sea.

chunks.text: Can you pass me the ..., please?
chunks.example: Can you pass me the glue, please?

chunks.text: There is a ... next to / under the ...
chunks.example: There is a cat under the tree.

talkMissions.title: What are you doing?
talkMissions.goal: Present continuous in real time. The child draws something while talking; Pip asks 'What are you doing? What are you drawing now?' and the child narrates. Pip also narrates what he is 'doing' (painting the Zoot sky).
talkMissions.opener: I'm painting a picture of Zoot. I'm painting the purple sky now! What are you doing? Are you drawing too?

talkMissions.title: Picture detective
talkMissions.goal: Child describes a picture she drew (shapes, colours, where things are with in/on/under/next to). Pip 'can't see it' and asks questions to draw it himself; he makes a funny mistake so she must correct him.
talkMissions.opener: Oh no, I can't see your picture! Tell me about it, please. I want to draw it too. What can you see in your picture?
targets: There is a ... next to / under the ...
hints: There is a house next to a tree.
There is a cat under the table.

talkMissions.title: Our storybook
talkMissions.goal: Plan the 4-page storybook together: who is the hero, where it happens, what problem, how it ends. Child gives ideas, Pip adds one idea and asks 'What happens next?'.
talkMissions.opener: Let's make a storybook together! Every story needs a hero. Who is the hero of our story?
hints: The hero is a small cat.
She lives in a big forest.
At the end they are friends.

letters.subject: Earth is beautiful!
letters.body:
Dear friend,
I am sitting under a big tree now. I am drawing the sea. The sea is blue and green, and there are white boats on it. A little bird is looking at my picture. It is very funny! On Zoot I draw with moon rocks. On Earth I draw with crayons. What do you draw with?
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip what you are doing now. What do you like to draw with?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e şu anda ne yaptığını yaz. Resim çizerken neyi kullanmayı seversin?

letters.subject: A shape monster
letters.body:
Dear friend,
Today I am making a monster with shapes! Its head is a big circle. Its eyes are two small triangles. Its body is a square and its legs are long lines. It has got a star on its tummy. It looks like a robot! Can you make a shape monster too? Tell me about it.
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Draw a shape monster and tell Pip about it. What shapes and colours are in it?
letters.replyPromptTr: Şekillerden bir canavar çiz ve Pip'e anlat. Hangi şekiller ve renkler var?

questions.q: What shape is the monster's head?

letters.subject: Help me, please!
letters.body:
Dear friend,
I am making a book for my sister Mimi. But I have got a problem. I can't find my scissors and my glue! Are they under the bed? No. Are they in my bag? No! Oh, they are next to the window. Now I am cutting and gluing. Are you making a storybook too? What is it about?
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip about your storybook. Who is the hero? What happens?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e hikâye kitabını anlat. Kahraman kim? Neler oluyor?

story.title: My first storybook
story.prompt: Make a 4-page storybook with your own drawings. Who is the hero? What happens?
story.promptTr: Kendi çizimlerinle 4 sayfalık bir hikâye kitabı yap. Kahraman kim? Neler oluyor?

pages.prompt: Page 1: Who is the hero? Where does he or she live?
Page 2: What is the hero doing one day?
pages.promptTr: Sayfa 2: Bir gün kahraman ne yapıyor?

pages.prompt: Page 3: Oh no! What is the problem?
Page 4: How does the story end?

explorer.title: Mixing colours
explorer.text: Red, yellow and blue are primary colours. You can't make them with other colours. But you can mix them! Red and yellow make orange. Blue and yellow make green. Red and blue make purple. Artists mix colours on a palette. Try it with your paints!
facts: Red, yellow and blue are primary colours.

questions.q: What do red and yellow make?
What do red and blue make?

explorer.title: Animal artists
explorer.text: Some animals are artists too! The bowerbird lives in Australia. The boy bird makes a little house with sticks. Then he puts blue things next to it: flowers, shells and stones. He wants a girl bird to like his house. Pufferfish draw big circles in the sand under the sea. They look like beautiful pictures!
facts: Pufferfish draw circles in the sand.

questions.q: What colour things does the bowerbird like?

assessment.pictureTask: Look at the picture and tell Pip what you can see. What animals and colours can you see? What is the girl doing?
